Chronology of every recorded fact about [[script-circle]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Blackflame ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 3''' — The training dummies are arranged around an intricate script-circle.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|'''Ch 13''' — A Forger technique might involve strapping a binding into a script circle.}}

== Skysworn ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|'''Ch 2''' — Script-circles can be activated by pouring madra into them.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|'''Ch 3''' — Renfei uses a ceramic half-disc etched with part of a script-circle as a key.}}

== Ghostwater ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 3''' — A massive script-circle was used to create a bubble that held the water at bay.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 6''' — Script-circles are inscribed on surfaces to contain madra or serve other functions.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 12''' — Ziel uses a floating script-circle forged out of green light as a shield.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 15''' — A green script-circle can bloom above a person.}}

== Underlord ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 3''' — Lindon completed a script-circle on the door.}}

== Wintersteel ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 17''' — Lindon was examining a script-circle on a wall.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 19''' — A script-circle can be used to open a mechanical box.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 28''' — A script-circle can be a simple repelling script meant to keep out weak Remnants.}}

== Bloodline ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|'''Ch 2''' — A script-circle on a panel can display figures made of light.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|'''Ch 12''' — A script-circle can bind a person's spirit.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|'''Ch 19''' — A script-circle wall exists that the Spear of the Hollow King had to pass through.}}

== Reaper ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|'''Ch 20''' — Ziel operates script-circles to make his runes last longer.}}

== Dreadgod ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 10''' — Ziel can forge a script-circle to create a plane of force.}}

== Waybound ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|'''Ch 29''' — A script-circle can contain the impact of a fight and generate an invisible wall.}}
